table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ServiceType = (SELECT ST.Name FROM ServiceType ST WHERE ST.ServiceTypeCode = service.serviceTypeCode),
	itemname = service.name,
	reprintdate = getDate(),
	username=users.username,  
	code=dbo.serviceoheader.serviceocode,
	doctor=(select name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=serviceoheader.doctcode),   
	date=dbo.serviceoheader.date,  
	headerno=dbo.serviceoheader.headerno,
	discperc=dbo.serviceoheader.discperc,   
	misccharges=dbo.serviceoheader.misccharges,   
	custcode=dbo.serviceoheader.custcode,   
	remarks=dbo.serviceoheader.remarks,
	flatdisc=dbo.serviceoheader.flatdisc,
	servicecode=dbo.service.servicecode,   
	price = dbo.serviceodetail.price, 
	serviceflatdisc = dbo.serviceodetail.serviceflatdisc, 
	Qty = dbo.serviceodetail.qty,
	serviceodetail_discperc = serviceodetail.discperc, 
	customername=(SELECT Accounts.Name FROM Accounts WHERE Accounts.AccCode  = serviceoheader.Custcode),
	regno=patient.regno,
	patient=patient.name,
	ageyears = patient.ageyears,
	agemonths = patient.agemonths,
	agedays = patient.agedays,
	sex=patient.gender,
	mobile = patient.mobileno1,
	email = patient.email,
	dbo.serviceoheader.saleinvcode,
	PrintAmtOnServiceInv=Customer.PrintAmtOnServiceInv,
	RowID = serviceodetail.srvorowid,
	ReceivedAmt = serviceoheader.CashReceived,
	Message = (SELECT M.Description FROM Message M WHERE M.MessageCode = serviceoheader.MessageCode)
FROM 
	dbo.serviceoheader LEFT OUTER JOIN Patient ON (dbo.serviceoheader.patientcode = patient.patientcode),   
	Customer,
	dbo.serviceodetail,  
	service, 
	users
WHERE 
	( dbo.serviceoheader.serviceocode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.serviceoheader.serviceocode = dbo.serviceodetail.serviceocode ) AND 
	( dbo.serviceoheader.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
	( dbo.serviceoheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( serviceodetail.servicecode = service.servicecode )
ORDER BY 
	RowID
